description: Inspect, synchronize and deploy repositories within configured access levels
author: Serg Parf

autopull.help: Show the last result; now runs one update in the configured mode (deploy role required)

args.name: now
args.help: true to run one update; text form: autopull <repo> now

status.help: Show branch, changed paths and untracked files

rev.help: Show HEAD and branch, or detached state

fetch.help: Fetch upstream; show ahead and behind counts

diff.help: Show local change statistics and untracked paths

pull.help: Fast-forward only; with rev, detached checkout; with rev and file, restore that file

args.name: file
args.help: Literal relative file path at that revision

deploy.help: Fetch and deploy the configured/current or named branch, optionally one reachable revision; answer the result record

args.name: branch
args.help: Branch; a configured pin cannot be overridden

args.name: rev
args.help: 7..40 lower-case hex, reachable from the origin branch

args.name: id
args.help: Optional correlation id, 1..64 letters, digits, dot, underscore or hyphen (JSON form)

reset.help: Hard reset to the configured branch’s upstream; discards changes

args.name: paths
args.help: Paths to stage; JSON array, text has one or more words

commit.help: Commit staged changes as this server’s git identity

args.name: message
args.help: Commit message; quote it in text calls

push.help: Push using this server’s identity and SSH key

help.help: Describe this agent and the help-config and help-secret asks

repos.help: Local name to path, access, optional branch, mode (ff default or mirror) and follow (false default); mirror/follow need deploy or commit access; optional autopull-success-script/autopull-fail-script choose bare names installed by the host admin under the git state directory autopull.d, never paths

ssh_key.help: Absolute private-key file path, never key bytes; absent uses the service account’s keys

autopull-cmd.help: Optional command pubsub channel; required for follow

autopull-log.help: Optional result pubsub channel; absent means no publication
